name: Geo Sleuth
description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with DipoleML, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
